title: Clocked Goat Ride
style: Heavy trap with melody-first chorus hooks, hard 808 sub-bass, punchy punch-in kicks, razor hi-hats, and a ticking clock effect driving tension. Epic stadium crowd ambience, brass hits, distorted synth risers, and deep reverb on vocal ad-libs. Tight, aggressive mix with wide low end and high-impact drops.
lyrics: 🎤 LET’S RIDE! TURN THE BASS UP FOR THE GOAT! 🎧(Beat: A heavy, cinematic trap beat with a ticking clock sound effect and an epic stadium crowd roaring in the background)🔊 [INTRO: KELVIN]Yeah… look at the clock. June 2026.They said the tank would be empty by now.They said the engine would stall.But we don't stall. We don't brake.We don't crash… WE RIDE.Rafa, talk to ’em!⚡ [VERSE 1: RAFA]Forty-one on the passport, but twenty-one on the pitch,Swapping the script, making the critics flip a switch!Six World Cups, yeah, nobody’s touching the stat,Living legend, FIF champion, look at the crown on the mat.From Madeira to Manchester, Madrid to the states,Stepping onto the grass, rewriting the book of the fates.They wanted the downfall, wanted the wreck in the lane,But the CR7 engine only runs on the pressure and pain!Portugal on the chest, fire burning right in the eyes,Watch the number seven jersey take flight in the skies.DR Congo in the way? Man, it’s just another page,For the greatest to ever do it to illuminate the stage!💥 [CHORUS: KELVIN & RAFA]We don't crash, we ride! (We ride!)Pushing the limit, the legacy alive! (Alive!)FIF champion, standing in the zone,Sprinting past the doubts to claim the final throne.Hear the stadium echo, hear the stadium roar,SIUUU to the world, we are back for more!No emergency brakes, no shifting to the side,Kelvin and Rafa on the track—for Ronaldo, WE RIDE!🔥 [VERSE 2: KELVIN]Five Champions Leagues chilling back at the crib,But he’s hungry for the one they said he’d never get.Feet moving like lightning, step-overs in the dark,Every time he touches the ball, he’s leaving a spark.Messi had his moment, but Cristiano wants the final word,The loudest roar in the tournament that you ever heard.June 15th passed, the campaign has officially begun,Chasing the gold trophy under the American sun.They call it the Last Dance, we call it the victory lap,Putting respect on the name, locking it down in a rap!No seatbelts needed when you're moving at this speed,Ronaldo’s the blueprint, the definition of the breed!👑 [BRIDGE: RAFA]Look at the jersey. Seven. It’s a symbol of grit.Every drop of sweat, every single hit.They talked about the age, they talked about the end,But the GOAT doesn’t break, and the GOAT doesn't bend!🚀 [OUTRO: KELVIN & RAFA]The whistle blows. The stadium ignites.Six tournaments deep, reaching new heights.Kelvin and Rafa. Keeping the respect high.We don't crash. We don't stop. We don't die.We just ride.SIUUUUUUU!(Beat fades out with the sound of a stadium cheering CR7's name)Would you like me to add another verse focusing on Portugal's next opponent, or should we break down Ronaldo's real-time stats from the opening match? Let me know how you want to keep this hype train moving!
